incident_updates.body: What happened? On November 13, 2026 at 11:32 EST (16:32 UTC), we detected suspicious activity in one of our internal cloud environments. Our initial investigation confirmed unauthorized access to an internal system. This system does not store or process customer data. Following our incident response procedures, we immediately took all of our services offline as a precaution while we investigated. At this stage, we have found no evidence that customer data, secrets, or source code were exposed. We are working all hands on the deck to determine the full scope and to restore our services as soon as possible. What we recommend As a precaution, once our services are restored, we recommend that you rotate all secrets, access tokens, and certificates stored in Bitrise. What’s next Our teams are working on completing the investigation and to restore all services safely. We understand the impact this has on your work and appreciate your patience. Services: All Services Scope: All Users Severity: SEV-1 When will the next update be available? You can expect a status update approximately 1 hour from now.

incident_updates.body: We are responding to a security incident affecting some of Bitrise’s internal secrets, detected within the last hour. As a precaution we have temporarily taken Bitrise offline. We have no confirmation that any customer data or source code was accessed and are investigating urgently. Out of an abundance of caution, we recommend rotating any Git and source-code access credentials connected to Bitrise. We will share updates as soon as we know more. Scope: All Users Severity: SEV 1 When will the next update be available? You can expect a status update approximately 1 hour from now.
